nodes.description: bytes32 public name; wallet label set in constructor
address public creator; set to msg.sender in constructor
uint public allowance; tracked ETH balance of the wallet
address[] public owners; multisig owner set used for authorization
Log[] logs; deposit history entries
Transaction[] transactions; native-currency transaction queue
tokenTransaction[] tokenTransactions; ERC20 transaction queue
uint public approvalsreq; required number of confirmations
modifier onlyOwner(); loops owners to authorize msg.sender, silently no-ops when not found
constructor(uint _approvals, address[] _owners, bytes32 _name) payable; initializes wallet
fallback function () external payable; credits msg.value to allowance
getOwners() view returning owners array
getTxnNum() view returning transactions.length
getTxn(uint _id) view returning a stored Transaction
getLogsNum() view returning logs.length
getLog(uint logId) view returning log sender and amount
getTokenTxnNum() view returning tokenTransactions.length
getTokenTxn(uint _id) view returning a stored tokenTransaction
topBalance() payable; credits msg.value to allowance and appends a Log
submitTransaction(address,uint,bytes) onlyOwner; pushes a new native Transaction
confirmTransaction(uint) onlyOwner; adds msg.sender to confirmed list
executeTxn(uint) onlyOwner; performs low-level call then updates status and allowance
submitTokenTransaction(address,address,uint) onlyOwner; queues an ERC20 transfer
confirmTokenTransaction(uint) onlyOwner; adds msg.sender to token txn confirmed list
executeTokenTxn(uint) onlyOwner; calls balanceOf then token transfer and marks executed
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and record creation
dest.call.value(val)(dat); arbitrary external call with user-controlled target and data
txn.token.transfer(txn.reciever, txn.value); external ERC20 call on an attacker-supplied token address
txn.token.balanceOf(address(this)); external ERC20 call on an attacker-supplied token address
